130.manual_summary: A traction request is detected while the seat switch does not confirm operator presence. The system blocks movement to prevent unsafe operation.

131.manual_summary: The onboard charger is connected to mains power while a drive command is active. Traction is inhibited for safety reasons.

132.manual_summary: A drive command is detected while the onboard charger connector is not seated in the vehicle. This represents an invalid operating state.

135.manual_summary: The detected traction direction signals are not permitted for single-pedal operation. Input plausibility has failed.
actions_summary: Verify correct configuration for monopedal operation

150.manual_summary: The indicated remaining battery capacity has dropped to a low threshold level. Performance may be reduced.

151.manual_summary: The remaining battery capacity has reached a critical low threshold. Functional limitations are expected.

200.manual_summary: The control module factory test was not completed successfully or was not executed. Module configuration may be invalid.

210.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is above the permitted operating range.

211.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is below the permitted operating range.

212.manual_summary: The traction sensor supply voltage is outside valid operating limits. Sensor data cannot be trusted.

231.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance signal is detected outside the permitted range. Input plausibility is violated.

232.manual_summary: The accelerator reference signal is outside the valid operating range.

233.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance and reference signals do not correlate correctly. Dual-channel plausibility check failed.

241.manual_summary: The steering angle sensor channel 1 signal is outside the permitted range.

242.manual_summary: The steering angle sensor channel 2 signal is outside the permitted range.

243.manual_summary: The two steering angle sensor channels provide incompatible signals. Steering position cannot be validated.

351.manual_summary: The detected traction motor temperature is outside the permissible operating range.

353.manual_summary: The traction motor temperature has exceeded the allowable limit. Protective measures may be active.

391.manual_summary: The oil temperature sensor provides an implausible or incorrect signal.
actions_summary: Compare reading with actual oil temperature

443.manual_summary: Traction is not fully disabled although the seat switch is not active. A safety inconsistency is detected.

491.manual_summary: The safety check of the traction power module has failed. A safety-related fault is present.

502.manual_summary: The brake pressure signal is outside the permitted operating range. Correct braking performance cannot be ensured.

614.manual_summary: The seat switch reports an implausible state where both contacts are open or closed simultaneously.
actions_summary: Check wiring for shorts or opens

750.manual_summary: Traction has been disabled by the safety processor due to detected unsafe operating conditions.
